title: anneslia californica
intro: Anneslia californica, commonly known as California prickly poppy or California prickly poppy weed, is a flowering plant in the madder family (Rubiacaeae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of Anneslia californica are attributed to its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a popular choice for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Anneslia californica include alkaloids, flavonoids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
